remarks: MULTIPLE OFFERS - Highest & Best Offers Due Tuesday MAY 19th by 5pm. Move-in ready 3-bedroom ranch in the highly desirable Springdale neighborhood, offering a bright, open layout and exceptional updates throughout. Filled with natural light and hardwood floors, the main level features a spacious living room with gas fireplace that flows seamlessly into the dining area with access to a private deck, ideal for entertaining. The updated kitchen is finished with quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a classic subway tile backsplash. All three bedrooms are well sized and located on the main level, along with a renovated full bathroom. The finished lower level adds valuable living space with new LVP flooring, a second full bath, mudroom, and direct access to the attached one-car garage, plus excellent storage. Recent upgrades include a new roof and gutters, full interior and exterior painting, newer A/C wall unit, and a new hot water and heating combination system. City water, sewer, and natural gas. Set on a large backyard and ideally located near restaurants, shopping, Metro North, and local parks. New playground coming soon at Haig Park.
